rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARzart
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1994).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1994 as 'Renaissance'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Strong fragrance. 24 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 3' (60 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Amber Queen ® (floribunda, Harkness before 1981) ×
Margaret Merril (Floribunda, Harkness, 1977)
rows.Notes: Fryer's Roses says Renaissance has large, rounded full petalled blooms of blush pink with a hint of cream...
